decisive_join: Separate behavioral simulation from test-only batteries and recover the legal job-relevance correction without manufacturing an employer-specific legal conclusion or an individual false-negative rate.

findings.claim: Behavioral simulations, personality inventories, aptitude tests, and instruction-following exercises sample different evaluative objects; a long test battery does not become an assessment center through duration.
limits: The source defines method categories and does not judge the validity of an unrecovered employer battery.

findings.claim: Civil-rights law and professional guidance created genuine job-relevance, adverse-impact, and administration constraints without resolving every individual false negative or novelty-loss question.
limits: Jurisdiction, protected class, instrument, adverse-impact denominator, accommodation facts, and alternatives remain deployment-specific.

findings.claim: No source in this lane establishes the scores, accommodation disposition, causal rejection rule, discrimination, or legality of the private candidate transaction.
limits: The private archive remains digest-only and no employer record was recovered.
